Structure

| children | slot | — | Avatar content |

### Keypad

#### For AI agents

- Uses variables: background/muted
- Nested: KeypadButton
- Explicit (from Figma):
  - Keypad
  - Numeric keypad component used for currency/amount entry.
  - Matches  app/components/Base/Keypad/index.tsx
  - Structure
  - Keypad — vertical container (gap 12px)
  - Keypad.Row — horizontal row (gap 12px, space-between)
  - Keypad.Button — digit/period key (bg background/muted, radius 12, height 48)
  - Keypad.DeleteButton — backspace icon (transparent bg)
  - Props
  - | Prop | Type | Description |
  - |------|------|-------------|
  - | value | string | Current input value |
